question: Within 160 kilometers, where can I find a fast food restaurant ahead of Elyria Arts Council, Elyria, OH toward North Olmsted Recreation Center, North Olmsted, OH?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Elyria Arts Council%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Elyria%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%OH%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%North Olmsted Recreation Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%North Olmsted%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%OH%' LIMIT 1 ), -- Calculate the target azimuth (bearing) from the start point to the end point target_azimuth_calc AS ( SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry::geography, e.geometry::geography)) AS target_azimuth_deg FROM start_point s, end_point e ), -- Find fast food restaurants within 160 km of the start point and calculate their bearing fast_food_pois_with_bearing AS ( SELECT p.poi_name, p.geometry, degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography)) AS current_poi_azimuth, sp.geometry AS start_geom, tac.target_azimuth_deg FROM pois p, start_point sp, target_azimuth_calc tac WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, sp.geometry::geography, 160000) -- 160 km = 160,000 meters ) SELECT ff.poi_name FROM fast_food_pois_with_bearing ff WHERE -- Filter by direction: within +/- 45 degrees of the target bearing -- Calculate the shortest angular distance, handling the 0/360 degree wrap-around LEAST( ABS(ff.current_poi_azimuth - ff.target_azimuth_deg), 360 - ABS(ff.current_poi_azimuth - ff.target_azimuth_deg) ) <= 45 ORDER BY ST_Distance(ff.geometry::geography, ff.start_geom::geography) ASC;

answers.poi_name: Wallace Lake Bathhouse and Concession Building
